ruleDefinitions.name: SCM Database Privileged Operation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects non-system users performing privileged operation os the SCM database Note: Unmapped fields: ObjectType, ObjectName, PrivilegeList, SubjectLogonId, ProcessName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4674 AND ObjectType = "SC\_MANAGER\ OBJECT" AND ObjectName = "servicesactive" AND PrivilegeList = "SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege") AND  NOT ((SubjectLogonId = "0x3e4" AND ProcessName = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\services\\\.exe$")))
